scope: Where the candidate machines resolve or refine SPECIFICATION.md 4.3 and HARDENING_TRANSITION_RULES.md. Each amendment is cited from the CESs that carry it (sequences[].metadata.semanticAmendments). None is approved; each is for owner review.

amendments.change: Open interval bounds are written closed, 0.0001 inside the open end: (0.05, 1.0] becomes [0.0501, 1.0], [0.0, 0.50) becomes [0.0, 0.4999].
amendments.reason: The threshold comparator accepts a closed interval |value - input| <= t; it has no open bound.

amendments.applies: GOV01, GOV04, GOV12, GOV13, GOV17 (PARKED); GOV07, GOV14, GOV16 (APPROACH)
amendments.change: A status the specification states as a state (ParkedReview, AwaitingQuorum, Assembling, NoticeParked, RotationParked, Warning, RenewalWindow, DelegationThrottle) is an output element, and its symbol carries the conditions that end it (no approval yet, not re-pinned, not stale, not latched).
amendments.reason: A final Reality Event asserts for as long as it keeps matching (SURFACE_SPEC.md), so a status without its ending conditions would assert beside the state that replaced it.

amendments.change: The approval symbol also requires lane_stale = 0.
amendments.reason: As written, S2 -> S3 does not exclude a stale continuation while S2 -> S_err fires on one, so both transitions are enabled at once; fail-safe resolution, the escape wins.

amendments.change: The guard (req_domain_admit or req_epoch_swap) and aibom is split into one CES per request.
amendments.reason: One CES is one regular expression with no alternation (owner rule 2026-10-05).

amendments.change: The hardened permit preconditions (lane_quorum_integrity_ok, gate_source_slsa_attested) each get their own HALT path.
amendments.reason: HARDENING_TRANSITION_RULES.md section 1 adds them to the permit only; without a fail path a missing attestation would leave the monitor silent instead of halting.

amendments.applies: GOV07, GOV09, GOV12, GOV14, GOV16, GOV17
amendments.change: An SR latch on a fixture Q(k) = S(k) or (not R(k) and Q(k-1)) is built from a feedback input element (latch_q_prev, composed by the PE), one set CES per set disjunct (debounced, GOV-SA-19), one hold CES per negated literal of R, and an explicit release CES. Where a watchdog dispatches an agent, the release also requires the agent's completion (triage before release). Templates hold no latch: the frame's lanes carry their state.
amendments.reason: The engines keep no state a CES can test across steps except active events, and a final event asserts only while it matches; the release is explicit so the latch never depends on whether an unwritten cell keeps its value.

amendments.change: Stateless: HALT while the gate fails or drift > 0.10, PERMIT while both are within the gate.
amendments.reason: The specification's S1 -> S0 condition is the exact complement of S0 -> S1, so no state is needed.

amendments.change: GOV10 runs per outbound message: every path requires req_egress, so it never permits on a quiet step. This closes GOV-R13.
amendments.reason: Owner decision GOV-SD-07 (every Source in v1) adds the boundary's pending-message signal.

amendments.change: Emergency activation also requires lane_re_pinned = 0.
amendments.reason: Otherwise a tampered frame would assert PERMIT_DEPLOY and HALT_PROMOTION together.

amendments.change: The emergency prefix requires lane_quorum_met = 0, so the emergency state and its incident trail end at post-hoc ratification.
amendments.reason: As written, EmergencyActive's guard still holds after ratification and would keep asserting the incident.

amendments.change: GOV00 folds the fixtures' verdicts only (GOV06, 07, 08, 09, 14, 16): halt, revoke and incident by max; permit only while some fixture permits and none halts or revokes. Templates report through their continuation and their agent's completion, never by bus.
amendments.reason: A clone leaves only by continuation or termination (CONTINUATIONS_APPROVAL_CHAIN.md); GOV-R17.

amendments.change: Each template hands its governed asset to the next consumer in the specification's evidence flow (document-workflow-handoff); the governed target domain is carried by the asset frame, not by a machine copy.
amendments.reason: Cloneable rule 1 needs an agentic action; owner decision GOV-SD-04 (17 machines).

amendments.change: A failed agent step asserts PARKED and REWORK: it parks for the case's author, with no escape or restart of its own.
amendments.reason: Owner rule 2026-11-14 (failed step parks; Manager#346): the dispatcher retries within the step, then the lifecycle parks a re-run for the author.

amendments.change: An approval counts only after the parked, diff-shown state has held for DWELL (2) consecutive steps; an approval with no diff, or in the same step as the diff, halts.
amendments.reason: ASI09 approver fatigue and the hardening workplan's dwell requirement; the dwell is a step count, and a wall-clock dwell needs a timer Source.

amendments.change: A re-pin after approval halts and sends the frame to rework.
amendments.reason: T16 (approval of a changed document): the specification guards re-pin only before approval.

amendments.change: For a high-risk domain the audit blocks only when the review lease expires unsigned; awaiting the signature is not a failure.
amendments.reason: With an agent drafting the audit, 'not yet signed' is the parked state, not the specification's S_fail.

amendments.change: When the assembler reports nothing unpinned but the AIBOM verifier disagrees, the gate halts.
amendments.reason: The agent prepares; the verifier decides.

amendments.change: The approval quorum is valid only when the bundle was ready before the last signature arrived, with signatures from Risk, Engineering and Legal and no preparer among the signers; one CES per org unit whose signature arrives last.
amendments.reason: RESOLUTION_WORKPLAN.md 1.3 (cross-departmental quorum) and T15; the order replaces the specification's single quorum bit.

amendments.change: A watchdog trips on DEBOUNCE (3) consecutive breach observations (GOV09: 2), and GOV08 recovers on 2 consecutive in-gate observations.
amendments.reason: A single sample must not revoke an epoch; the specification's trips are single-sample.

amendments.change: Closing an incident frame asserts an explicit all-zero vector.
amendments.reason: The close is observable as a release rather than as silence.

amendments.change: A parked notice whose stale lane fires (the statutory clock, carried by the lifecycle's lease) is OVERDUE and re-raises the incident.
amendments.reason: EU AI Act Art. 73 deadlines; the engines count steps, so the clock is the lifecycle's.

amendments.change: Reaching expiry without a renewal window first asserts OVERDUE beside the revoke.
amendments.reason: CONNECTED_WORKFLOW.md 1.4: a missed window is its own finding.
